title: Faster everyday workflows
summary: AD Tools 1.3.6 makes saved work easier to reach, refreshes everyday tools, and uses fewer resources in the background.
notes: Quick Query preserves JSON and HTML content pasted from DBeaver or SQL Developer, and can expand or collapse the Data Sheet.
Pin favorite tools in the sidebar so they stay at the top.
Press ⌘K to search tools, pages, and saved Quick Query tables.
Home now shows your usage and includes a feedback field.
Check Image adds a clearer batch workflow, saved references, result filters, cancellation, and timeout retries.
Char Counter now has compact summary metrics and a Per row view for comparing line lengths.
Heavy tools and background work now release resources more efficiently to reduce RAM and compute usage.

slides.title: Quick Query: safer paste, flexible Data Sheet
slides.body: Move database results into Quick Query without breaking structured values, then reshape the Data Sheet around the work in front of you.
bullets: Paste rows from DBeaver or SQL Developer without losing quotes inside JSON or HTML values.
Expand or collapse the Data Sheet to match the task.

slides.title: Your shortcuts, wherever you are
slides.body: Keep frequent tools pinned in the sidebar, or press ⌘K to jump directly to a tool, page, or saved Quick Query table.
bullets: Right-click a sidebar tool to pin or unpin it.
Search remembers recent destinations and brings them forward.

slides.title: A more useful Home, Check Image, and Char Counter
slides.body: Home now combines usage context with a direct feedback field, Check Image makes repeated batch checks easier to manage, and Char Counter keeps text checks focused.
bullets: Save friendly labels for image identifiers you use often.
Filter results, cancel a run, and retry timed-out checks.
Configure CDN environment URLs from Settings.
Switch Char Counter to Per row to compare each line's character length while keeping the summary visible.

tips.title: Pin a favorite tool
tips.body: Open the sidebar, then right-click any tool and choose Pin. Pinned tools stay together at the top; repeat the action to unpin one.

tips.title: Search with ⌘K
tips.body: Press ⌘K from anywhere. Type qq: followed by a table name to open a saved Quick Query table directly.

tips.title: Send feedback from Home
tips.body: Choose a tool if relevant, describe what should be better, and send your note without leaving Home.

tips.title: Paste JSON and HTML safely
tips.body: Copy rows from DBeaver or SQL Developer, then paste them directly into the Data Sheet. Quotes and multiline content inside JSON or HTML values are preserved.

tips.title: Expand or collapse the Data Sheet
tips.body: Select Expand Data Sheet to use the available workspace for table data. Select it again to return to the split Query and Data Sheet view.

tips.title: Reuse image references
tips.body: Open Saved references to keep friendly labels beside identifiers you check often. Batch runs also support filtering, cancellation, and timeout retries.

tips.title: Compare rows at a glance
tips.body: Switch to Per row to see each line's character length while keeping the overall summary below.
